extracted.name: Pancakes - Joshua Weissman
extracted.description: Great recipe for Pancakes - Joshua Weissman.
instruction_lines: In a bowl mix the egg and the milk
In a separate bowl mix the flour, sugar, salt, baking soda and baking powder
Mix both bowls, once it's homogeneous add the butter and whisk until everything is throughoutly combined
Heat the pan and add a bit of butter or oil
Add a cup of mix and cook until golden brown, flip when it feels firm instead of waiting for bubbles to appear
